sections.title: 1. Introduction & Module Overview
sections.intro:
Mall Management module hotel ke attached mall/commercial complex ke shops aur tenants manage karta hai — lease agreements, monthly utility billing (electricity/water meter reading), service charges.

MALL FLOW: Shops register (Shop Master) → Lease agreement (tenant, rent, deposit, terms) → Daily meter reading (electricity/water) → Monthly bill generation (rent + utilities + service charges) → Collection tracking.

rows: Shop Master, Charge Master, Unit Type, Lease Agreement, Facility Sundry, Tenant Location
Service Bill Entry, Daily Meter Reading

subsections.title: Key Benefits
bullets: Shop-wise tenant ledger — rent, deposit, dues
Meter reading based utility billing — no disputes
Lease renewal reminders via agreement expiry

subsections.title: 2.1 Shop Master
subsections.navPath: Main Setup ▶ Mall Management ▶ Shop Master
subsections.paragraph: Mall ki saari shops/shops units register karo — shop no., floor, area (sqft), type. Lease agreement isi shop pe attach hota hai. Charge Master me facility charges (CAM) define hote hain, Unit Type me shop units, Tenant Location me tenant mapping.

subsections.title: 2.2 Lease Agreement Entry
subsections.navPath: Main Setup ▶ Mall Management ▶ Lease Agreement
subsections.paragraph: Tenant ka lease record — agreement no., tenant details, monthly rent, escalation %, security deposit, lease start/end dates, CAM charges. Expiry pe renewal follow-up.

subsections.title: 3.1 Daily Meter Reading
subsections.navPath: Mall Management ▶ Operation ▶ Daily Meter Reading
subsections.paragraph: By entering the reading of electricity/water meters of every shop daily/monthly — consumption units are calculated from the previous reading. Billing is based on these readings.

subsections.title: 3.2 Service Bill Entry
subsections.navPath: Mall Management ▶ Operation ▶ Service Bill Entry
subsections.paragraph: Tenant ka monthly bill — rent + meter consumption + CAM/service charges + GST. Bill print hota hai, tenant ledger me post hota hai. Payment receive hone pe settle hota hai.
